title: Apple’s rumored smart glasses were just confirmed by a supplier. Whoops!
content:
Macworld

Apple, as a general rule, is extremely secretive about its unreleased products. But that rule doesn’t always apply to its supplier partners, whose PR strategies may not be quite as strict or polished. And sure enough, one of those companies now appears to have revealed, quite blithely and deliberately, the existence of Apple’s rumored smart glasses project.

The Changzhou-based firm Quick Intelligent Equipment this week made its Q3 2026 earnings report. And according to a Chinese-language article by People’s Finance News (via MacRumors), this report contained the explosive claim that the supplier’s revenues were bolstered by working with Apple on a new set of “smart earphones” and a pair of AI glasses. Neither of those projects has yet been announced by Apple, and therefore neither of them has officially existed… until now.

“The company has participated in Apple’s AI glasses and new smart earphone projects, which will help drive related businesses such as precision welding assembly and machine vision inspection,” the report claims (via Google Translate), without appearing to realise how much trouble someone could get in for leaking that information anonymously, let alone publishing it in a public financial disclosure. (Quick Intelligent Equipment didn’t immediately respond to a request for comment.)

Granted, Apple itself leaked video of a new set of camera-equipped AirPods this summer, which is likely what the “smart earphones” refers to. But the AI glasses are simultaneously a bigger deal and a better-kept secret, and John Ternus will be very frustrated if a supplier really has spilled the beans in this bizarrely shameless way.

Apple has already entered the mixed-reality wearables business with the Vision Pro, but the company hopes at some point to launch something more portable and appealing to mainstream users. Widely referred to by external media as Apple Glass, and reportedly known at Apple Park by the codename N50, Apple’s first set of smart glasses are expected to be ready for a launch as soon as the first quarter of 2027. We’ll all have to pretend to be surprised.
